title: Checkmate in one
source: Original positions composed for this project by games/compose-chess.ts and verified with chess.js (not taken from any game or puzzle database).

hints: Look for a move that gives check and leaves the king nowhere to go.
puzzles.explain: The king is shut in by its own pawns, so it has no square to run to. The rook gives check along the back rank and nothing can block it or capture it. This is called a back-rank mate.

hints: Look for a move that gives check and leaves the king nowhere to go.
puzzles.explain: The black king is surrounded by its own rook and pawns, so it cannot move. The knight gives check, and a knight's check cannot be blocked. This is called a smothered mate.
